name: Daming Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Daming Electronics Co.,Ltd. engages in the production of automobile air-conditioning and acoustic systems. The company's products include air-conditioning control assy, power window switch, volume control switch series, combination switch series, steering wheel combination, door light control switch, instrument panel switch series, instrument of small switch, fog lamp switch series, electric rearview mirror switch, defrost switch series, trunk switch series, dimmer switch series, alarm switch series, console switch series, CD panel series, and vehicle power series. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Yueqing, China.
